issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame is constructed with format="RGB" but image.tobytes() returns bytes in the source mode (often RGBA or P)
issues.detail: PIL.Image.open infers mode from the decoded bytes; Gemini PNGs are frequently RGBA or palette. Calling image.tobytes() without convert("RGB") hands downstream consumers wrong-mode bytes mislabeled as RGB, producing corrupted or color-shifted output. Add image = image.convert("RGB") before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-import side effect mutates the private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE global
issues.detail: Reaching into a private attribute of google-genai at import time silently rewrites buffer size for every consumer in the process. The code itself labels it a "temporary hack" with no expiry, no upstream issue link, and an unjustified 5 MiB constant. Use a supported API, scope to the client instance, or upstream the fix before merging.

issues.description: Silent default model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: The default change shifts behavior for every caller who did not pin a model, with cost, latency, and thinking-budget implications. It is bundled into an image-generation PR with no in-code rationale. Split it into its own commit with explicit migration notes, or keep the prior default and require opt-in.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring "image" in model_name is brittle and conflates naming with capability
issues.detail: `if "image" in self._model_name` will misfire on any future model whose name happens to contain the substring and miss image-capable models that don't. Replace with an explicit allowlist of known image-capable model identifiers or a typed capability flag.

issues.description: No test coverage for the new inline_data image-emission path
issues.detail: The example script is not a test, and nothing pins the emitted frame's format, size, or byte-length. A unit test feeding a fake candidate with inline_data through _process_context and asserting the OutputImageRawFrame contents would have caught the format="RGB" bug. Add at minimum one such test before merge.

issues.description: Image part handling is inlined into the long candidate-processing loop instead of decomposed
issues.detail: The new elif part.inline_data branch sits inside a deeply nested for/if chain that mixes text, function calls, and image bytes with no documented invariant about ordering relative to LLMTextFrames. Extract a small pure part_to_frame(part) helper and document the emission ordering so downstream aggregators are not surprised.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Two real bugs must be fixed before merge: the OutputImageRawFrame is built with format="RGB" but emits raw bytes in whatever mode PIL inferred (often RGBA or palette), and a module-import monkey-patch mutates a private google-genai global for the whole process. The PR also bundles three independent changes — image support, a silent default-model bump to gemini-2.5-flash, and a multi-package dep bump — which should be split. Smaller concerns: substring-based model capability detection, no unit test for the inline_data branch, and an under-decomposed candidate loop. Fix the two P0s, split the PR, add tests, then resubmit.
